description: Proportional, cost-bounded /swarm acceptance canaries. Each canary is offline and deterministic: it asserts against the band sizer and budget counter in scripts/swarm_helper.py, never against un-instrumented wall-clock or token claims. Names match tests/test_proportional.py and SKILL.md §Proportionality guarantees.

evals.name: trivial-fast-path
evals.prompt: Launch the swarm on this one-line cosmetic rename. Review only.
evals.expected_output: select_band returns 'trivial'; size_cohort plans 1 reviewer, verifier 'no', second_pass 'no', max_dispatches 2; probe + 1 reviewer route to the economy class; no verifier.
assertions: Band is trivial for 1 root / <=5 files / <=100 lines / max score <40 / cosmetic / no protected axis
Cohort is exactly 1 reviewer with verifier 'no' and second_pass 'no'
Probe and reviewer both resolve through the shared catalog's economy tier
A 2-dispatch plan (probe + reviewer) passes the budget counter

evals.name: small-targeted
evals.prompt: Swarm this targeted change touching a couple of hotspots. Review only.
evals.expected_output: max score 40-59 selects 'small'; 1-2 reviewers, no verifier, <=3 dispatches; targeted reviewer routes through the shared catalog's standard tier.
assertions: Band is small for a single-root change with max score in 40-59
Cohort is 1-2 reviewers with verifier 'no'
A 3-dispatch plan passes and a 4th base dispatch is rejected by the small ceiling

evals.name: standard-specialist
evals.prompt: Launch the swarm on this change with a 60-79 driving dimension.
evals.expected_output: max score 60-79 selects 'standard'; 2-3 reviewers, specialist on the driving axis, verifier gated (only if a P0/P1 emerges).
assertions: Band is standard for a 60-79 driving dimension
Cohort is 2-3 reviewers with verifier 'gated' and second_pass 'no'
Specialist reviewer (score 60-89) routes through the shared catalog's deep tier

evals.name: deep-gated-verifier
evals.prompt: Dispatch the swarm on this security-sensitive change (D04 in the 60-79 range).
evals.expected_output: D04/D05/D07 in 60-79 (or max 80-89) selects 'deep'; 3-4 reviewers on the deep class, runtime /prompt-architect for the critical charter, gated verifier, second pass gated.
assertions: Band is deep for a protected axis in 60-79 or a max score of 80-89
Cohort is 3-4 reviewers with verifier 'gated' and second_pass 'gated'
Deep reviewers resolve through the shared catalog; a 6-dispatch plan passes and a 7th base dispatch is rejected

evals.name: critical-redundancy
evals.prompt: Run the swarm on this authorization and persistent-data boundary. Keep security and data-integrity reviews independently redundant.
evals.expected_output: a dimension >=90 (or D04/D05/D07 >=80) selects 'critical'; preflight reserves every critical territory, one bounded probe-blind duplicate, and one verifier. A seven-file/9,396-line source is section-packed at <=3,000 lines per assignment or refused before reviewer dispatch.
assertions: Band is critical for any dimension >=90 or a protected axis >=80
Cohort is 4-5 reviewers with verifier 'yes' and redundancy only on the >=90 axis
Critical reviewer (score >=90) resolves through the live-runtime-filtered critical tier
Seven files / 9,396 lines produce bounded evidence packs and exact candidate binding, never all lines per reviewer

evals.name: waiver-visibility
evals.prompt: Launch the swarm; most dimensions are low-scored. Show me what was not reviewed.
evals.expected_output: low-scored dimensions appear as 'waived' in the coverage matrix with the probe evidence supporting waiver; nothing is silently dropped; a named hotspot or confidence <70 blocks waiver.
assertions: The rendered report's coverage matrix marks each dimension reviewed, waived, or uncovered
Every waived dimension carries the probe evidence that supports the waiver
A low score with a named hotspot or confidence <70 is not silently waived

evals.name: dedup-fix-groups
evals.prompt: Swarm this; several reviewers will likely flag the same root cause.
evals.expected_output: multiple reviewer observations of one root cause collapse to a single curated fix group; the report shows <=10 curated findings and summarizes P3/P4 duplicates by count.
assertions: Findings sharing an evidence lineage and correction merge into one curated fix group
The curated report shows at most 10 findings
P3/P4 duplicates are summarized by count rather than listed individually

evals.name: budget-guard
evals.prompt: Launch the swarm and keep spending until you cannot.
evals.expected_output: accepted workers hard-stop at 9 and no new work starts after 20 minutes. Healthy completion gets a bounded 25-60 minute scope-aware allowance; stalled workers fail coverage; a third pass is refused.
assertions: A 10th total dispatch raises ContractError (absolute ceiling 9)
A new accepted worker at >1200s raises while a healthy large worker may complete after a small-task target within its allowance
A pass_index of 3 raises: never start a third pass

evals.name: fan-out-guard
evals.prompt: Launch the swarm; reviewers will ask for git history and test runs.
evals.expected_output: evidence requests are fulfilled by the parent and never by a dispatched subagent. Preflight/transport rejection is separate from accepted-worker capacity; every accepted worker counts once.
assertions: The budget counter rejects an 'evidence' dispatch kind (evidence is parent-run)
Only accepted probe/reviewer/verifier/escalation workers consume capacity; routing and transport attempts are separately bounded
There is no code path that dispatches a subagent to answer an evidence request

evals.name: routing-no-inheritance
evals.prompt: Launch the swarm and show the model routing for every role.
evals.expected_output: every dispatch carries a concrete catalog slug filtered through the executing runtime enum. An unavailable preference resolves to a valid configured fallback before dispatch; no valid candidate is a precise zero-launch preflight failure.
assertions: Every resolved role slug is a member of the routing catalog; 'inherit' never appears
route_probe consumes only root/file/line counts and protected-path presence, never scores
Runtime filtering never emits an unsupported stale slug; no valid configured candidate raises a precise preflight failure

evals.name: prompt-architect-coupling
evals.prompt: Launch the swarm with a hand-authored charter that skipped /prompt-architect.
evals.expected_output: the provenance lint fails a charter that has neither a committed template id in references/charters/PROVENANCE.md nor a recorded runtime /prompt-architect invocation; every committed charter template traces to the registry at version 3.2.2.
assertions: Every references/charters/*.md template id is registered in PROVENANCE.md
PROVENANCE.md pins /prompt-architect version 3.2.2 and the RISEN / TIDD-EC frameworks
A charter with no template id and no runtime /prompt-architect record fails the lint

evals.name: runaway-regression
evals.prompt: Prove a default swarm run cannot become the ~20-agent, 2-hour runaway.
evals.expected_output: the suite fails if a default run could accept >5 reviewers, exceed 9 accepted workers, omit required critical coverage, run an unreserved verifier, auto-start a second pass, or dispatch evidence gathering.
assertions: No band plans more than 5 reviewers (base max) and no band ceiling exceeds the absolute 9
A verifier dispatched with no P0/P1 gate trigger is a doctrine violation the render/report surfaces as not_evaluated
The counter refuses a second accepted probe/verifier, a third pass, and an evidence worker; capacity pressure preflight-refuses rather than truncates
